scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The picture becomes numbers
scenes.caption: Vihaan opens a fictional grayscale patch in the Decision Lab. Its rows are [10,20,30], [40,50,60] and [70,80,90]. Aditi separates the picture into measured pixels, keeping their locations attached so neighbours remain identifiable throughout the calculation.

scenes.dialogue: A pixel needs a value and a location.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Light the binary lamps
scenes.caption: The selected centre pixel has value 50. Using weights 128,64,32,16,8,4,2,1, they light the positions for 32,16 and 2. The eight-bit representation is 00110010; the leading zeros preserve the fixed width of the supplied encoding.

scenes.dialogue: The lit weights must add back.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: A handcrafted operation
scenes.caption: Their window covers a square of neighbouring pixels and adds its values. It moves across only positions that fit fully inside the patch, with no padding. This is an explicitly handcrafted local operation, not a trained convolutional neural network.

scenes.dialogue: State the operation and boundary convention.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Predict the next output
scenes.caption: Choose the top-right window result before revealing it. Its pixels are 20,30,50 and 60. Vihaan keeps the addition visible while Aditi moves the window; guessing from whether the patch looks bright would not reproduce the stated operation.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Assemble the feature grid
scenes.caption: The output rows are [120,160] and [240,280]. Their toy feature rule selects sums at least 200, so only the bottom row qualifies. Aditi labels output positions separately from input pixels to avoid applying the rule to the wrong grid.

scenes.dialogue: An output cell summarises a neighbourhood.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Change one input
scenes.caption: Changing the centre pixel to 0 produces [70,110] and [190,230]. Only the final output now qualifies. The arithmetic explains this sensitivity, while the operation still cannot tell what object is pictured or whether the image is meaningful to a person.
